race.comment: The feature of the day and the King of The West OVERPASS (1) deserves to be on top. He mightn't have the peaks of previous years, but his recent level of form is still good enough to win a race like this and he draws the inside today for Shinn. Should get things to suit and he can pick up his 3rd Winterbottom Stakes. REY MAGNERIO (2) somehow got out of jail to win Century Stakes on Oaks Day, coming from nowhere to mow down his rivals. Zahra makes the trip across to ride now and he's drawn to stalk the speed. Watch for him late in the race. SUPER SMINK (11) is back in WA and back into a suitable race. She finished nicely in The Nivison but was just outclassed in The Invitation at her last start. Third-up, back into a race like this, I think she brings some x-factor with a different formline. PERSIAN SPIRIT (5) can be in the mix as he prepares for the Gold Rush.
